title: Model first: finish a rename made in the designer
prompt: I've renamed Buyer to Customer in the Domain designer. Finish the rename in the code. Keep the database table and column names as they are.
done: the Buyer class is Customer in the code, every reference uses it, and the code builds

expect.text: Buyer's hand-written members (VerifyOrAddPaymentMethod and the rest) survive in Customer: nothing was lost to the renamed file.
The table stays buyers in the code and the model, and no migration renames it.
The model's Customer is still the element the developer renamed, not deleted and recreated.
